decision.explanation: The original sources provide conflicting dates for 'Richard Aldworth' depending on which individual is being referenced. Document D1S3 states that Richard Aldworth-Neville (2nd Baron Braybrooke) was born on 3 July 1750. Documents D2S2 and D3S3 both state that 'Aldworth' was born on 12 December 1750, likely referring to the same individual. Document D4S1 and D5S1 mention Richard Neville Aldworth Neville, born on 3 September 1717, who appears to be a different person (father of the 2nd Baron). All three claims are explicitly stated in their respective documents and refer to distinct individuals named 'Richard Aldworth' or variants thereof. Therefore, all three dates are valid under the given context.
